sources.citation: Bisht, R. S. 1982. "Excavations at Banawali, 1974–77." In Harappan Civilization: A Contemporary Perspective, edited by Gregory L. Possehl, 113–124. New Delhi: Oxford & IBH / American Institute of Indian Studies.
sources.notes: Primary ASI excavation summary for Banawali 1974–77 seasons (Pre-/Mature-/Post-Harappan sequence). Page range as published in Possehl 1982 volume; no invented find lists.

sources.citation: Possehl, Gregory L., and M. H. Raval. 1989. Harappan Civilization and Rojdi. New Delhi: Oxford & IBH / American Institute of Indian Studies; Leiden: E. J. Brill (ISBN 90-04-09157-1 / 978-90-04-09157-3).
sources.notes: Primary monograph on four seasons at Rojdi (Rajkot District, Saurashtra) by Gujarat State Archaeology and University of Pennsylvania.

sources.citation: Fairservis, Walter A., Jr. 1961. "The Harappan Civilization: New Evidence and More Theory." American Museum Novitates, no. 2055. New York: American Museum of Natural History.
sources.notes: AMNH Novitates synthesis of Harappan evidence and theory (1961). Secondary relative to site reports; useful for mid-20th-century research history.

sources.citation: Allchin, Bridget, and Raymond Allchin. 1968. The Birth of Indian Civilization: India and Pakistan before 500 B.C. Harmondsworth: Penguin Books (Pelican).
sources.notes: Broad Penguin survey of South Asian prehistory including Indus/Harappan. Secondary handbook; cross-check site claims against primary reports.

sources.citation: Possehl, Gregory L., ed. 1979. Ancient Cities of the Indus. Durham, N.C.: Carolina Academic Press / New Delhi: Vikas. ISBN 0-89089-093-5.
sources.notes: Edited compilation of key articles on Indus urbanism with bibliography. Secondary container; cite individual papers when claims are paper-specific.

sources.citation: Rao, S. R. 1985. Lothal: A Harappan Port Town (1955–62). Volume 2. Memoirs of the Archaeological Survey of India, no. 78. New Delhi: Archaeological Survey of India.
sources.notes: ASI Memoir 78 vol. 2 specialist reports (human/animal remains, chemical/botanical analyses, portable finds). Complements Rao 1979 vol. 1 already registered.

sources.citation: Bisht, R. S. 1984. "Structural Remains and Town-Planning of Banawali." In Frontiers of the Indus Civilization, edited by B. B. Lal and S. P. Gupta, 89–97. New Delhi: Books & Books.
sources.notes: Primary structural/town-planning discussion of Banawali based on ASI excavations. No invented street-grid measurements beyond published description.

sources.citation: Jansen, Michael, and Günter Urban, eds. 1984. Interim Reports Vol. 1: Reports on Field Work Carried out at Mohenjo-Daro, Pakistan, 1982–83 by the IsMEO–Aachen University Mission. Aachen / Rome: RWTH Aachen / IsMEO.
sources.notes: Primary interim field reports of the German–Italian documentation/excavation mission at Mohenjo-Daro (architectural documentation, non-invasive survey).

sources.citation: Shaffer, Jim G. 1992. "The Indus Valley, Baluchistan, and Helmand Traditions: Neolithic through Bronze Age." In Chronologies in Old World Archaeology, 3rd ed., edited by Robert W. Ehrich, vol. 1, 441–464. Chicago: University of Chicago Press.
sources.notes: Secondary chronological tradition essay framing Indus/Baluchistan/Helmand sequences. Useful for periodization pointers; not a substitute for site reports.

sources.citation: Kenoyer, Jonathan Mark. 1997. "Trade and Technology of the Indus Valley: New Insights from Harappa, Pakistan." World Archaeology 29 (2): 262–280.
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed craft/trade synthesis grounded in Harappa excavations (bead and related technologies). Complements Meadow/Kenoyer Harappa reports already registered.
